_note: Checked Sept 2026 against several independent listings. Ethiopia has no verified 24/7 suicide or counselling helpline listed on findahelpline.com; re-check before launch and add one if a verified service appears. Every line has an English and an Amharic form; name_am is only set where the name itself reads differently in Amharic.

always.en: If you are in immediate danger, call emergency services now.
always.am: አሁኑኑ አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ፣ ወዲያውኑ ወደ አስቸኳይ ጊዜ አገልግሎት ይደውሉ።

always.en: Reach out to someone you trust today — a family member, friend, priest or pastor.
always.am: ዛሬውኑ ለሚያምኑት ሰው — ለቤተሰብ፣ ለጓደኛ፣ ለካህን ወይም ለመጋቢ — ይንገሩ።

global.name: Ethiopia — Police / ፖሊስ
global.detail: If you or someone else is in danger
global.detail_am: እርስዎ ወይም ሌላ ሰው አደጋ ላይ ከሆነ

global.name: Amanuel Mental Specialized Hospital, Addis Ababa
global.name_am: አማኑኤል የአእምሮ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሆስፒታል፣ አዲስ አበባ
global.detail: Ethiopia's national psychiatric hospital — you can go in person for urgent mental health care
global.detail_am: የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ የአእምሮ ሕክምና ሆስፒታል — ለአስቸኳይ የአእምሮ ጤና እርዳታ በአካል መሄድ ይችላሉ

global.name: Find A Helpline (outside Ethiopia)
global.detail: Free, confidential crisis lines in 130+ countries, by phone, text or chat
global.detail_am: ከ130 በላይ በሆኑ አገሮች ነጻና ሚስጥራዊ የእርዳታ መስመሮች — በስልክ፣ በጽሑፍ መልእክት ወይም በቻት
